blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Sugar is our product. Sugar is uncountable. We do not say "one sugar" or "two sugars". We say some sugar, a lot of sugar, or ten tonnes of sugar.

To count sugar, we use tonnes. We say "There are many tonnes" and "There is a lot of sugar". We ask "How much sugar is there?" and "How many tonnes are there?"

Today we learn five words: sugar, tonne, cargo, quality, and quantity. A little English every day is a lot.

items.q: Is sugar countable or uncountable?
items.why: "Sugar is uncountable." — não dizemos one sugar, two sugars.

items.q: What do we use to count sugar?
items.why: "To count sugar, we use tonnes."

items.q: Which question is correct for sugar?
items.why: Sugar é incontável, então usamos "how much": "How much sugar is there?"

items.q: The text suggests that the writer would NOT say…
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que não falamos "one sugar" ou "two sugars".

items.q: "A little English every day is a lot." This suggests that…
options: small daily study helps a lot
you must study only one day
items.why: Inferência: estudar um pouco todo dia soma muito.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Ethan mostrando ao novo trader como descrever uma carga de açúcar. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, welcome to the team. Today I show you how to describe a sugar cargo. It is easy. We talk about three things: quality, quantity, and type.

First, the quantity. How much sugar is there? Here we have ten thousand tonnes. That is a lot of sugar. We do not say "one sugar" or "two sugars". Sugar is uncountable. We say some sugar, a lot of sugar, or ten thousand tonnes.

Second, the quality. Is the quality high or low? This cargo has high quality. Good quality is very important for our clients.

Third, the type. Is it white sugar or raw sugar? This cargo is raw sugar.

Now, the cargo is on the ship. We have many tonnes and we have some clients in Asia. We export a lot of sugar every month.

So remember: quantity, quality, and type. Use "how much" for sugar and "how many" for tonnes. A little English every day is a lot. Good luck!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What three things does Ethan talk about?
items.why: "We talk about three things: quality, quantity, and type."

items.q: How much sugar is there in the cargo?
items.why: "Here we have ten thousand tonnes."

items.q: Where is the cargo now?
items.why: "Now, the cargo is on the ship."

items.q: Ethan suggests that high quality is…
items.why: Inferência: "Good quality is very important for our clients."

items.q: From the talk, we can guess that the company…
options: sells a lot of sugar often
items.why: Inferência: "We export a lot of sugar every month" e tem clientes na Ásia.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "We sell a lot of sugar every year." Sugar means…
items.why: Sugar = açúcar, o produto da empresa.

items.q: "There are ten thousand tonnes on the ship." A tonne is…
items.why: Tonne = tonelada métrica, usada para medir o açúcar.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The ___ is on the ship. It has ten thousand tonnes of sugar."
items.why: Cargo = carga; é o que está no navio.

items.q: "The quality is high." Quality means…
items.why: Quality = qualidade (alta ou baixa).

items.q: Choose the correct word: "How much sugar is there? The ___ is ten thousand tonnes."
items.why: Quantity = quantidade; responde "how much / how many".

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem em reuniões de negócios. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "There is a lot of sugar on the ship." A lot of means…
items.why: A lot of = muito/muita — uma grande quantidade.

items.q: "We have some clients in Asia." Some means…
items.why: Some = alguns/algumas — uma quantidade não exata.

items.q: The boss says: "Can you sign off on the cargo?" This means…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval.

items.q: "We ship out the sugar today." To ship out means to…
items.why: Ship out = enviar/despachar a mercadoria.

items.q: "Let's find out how much sugar is there." To find out means to…
items.why: Find out = descobrir, obter a informação.
